utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Gus — that tool list sounds just right for now. Please keep it parked there until Sam confirms the accepted items and volunteers, then we’ll spread the word cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Eli—I’ll keep the tools set aside and won’t point anyone your way until Sam’s list is final. If you need me to add or swap anything once it lands, just holler.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — that’s exactly the steady approach I like. Once Sam’s list comes in, I’ll check it against your tools and give you a clear yes-or-swap note.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Jules—quick correction before I muddle it again: the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and they’re collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs, especially anything safety-related like porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Oren—that helps a lot. I’ll pass along Sunday at the community center and the safety-related focus, but I’m still going to confirm the organizer name and full repair categories with Opal before asking folks to commit.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds wise, Jules—please do confirm with Opal, and maybe just tell folks for now to sign up with what needs fixing rather than promising any specific tools or categories yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard that the table area is approved yet, Pia, so I’d keep that marked pending too. I’ll wait for Faye or the manager to confirm before we share any location details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep everything quiet for now and just tell anyone who asks that the repair drive details are still pending.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds right, Pia—thanks for being careful. If Faye confirms the priorities, organizer, sign-ups, or table approval, I’ll pass along only those confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara — I’ve only been hearing this second-hand, so I wanted to check with you before I repeat anything: is Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes the actual repair window, or just sign-ups?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good catch, Nell — Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes is sign-ups only, not the actual repair window and no tool drop-off yet. If you spread the word, please say we still need intake volunteers and a few basic tool kits lined up for later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll make sure to say Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes is sign-ups only, with no tool drop-off yet. I’ll also mention you still need intake volunteers and a few basic tool kits lined up for later.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll tell folks the key thing is to sign up ahead and list what they’re bringing, but I’ll keep it low-key until the rest of the details are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Bo—thank you. I’ll let you know as soon as Faye and I have the time, place, and repair scope nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Ira—send me the finalized time, place, and repair scope when you’ve got it, and I’ll stick to the sign-up message for now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, I’m updating the repair drive supply list—do you know if you’re bringing any tools, spare parts, duct tape, or batteries, or have you heard who’s confirmed the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can bring duct tape, a basic tool kit, and a pack of batteries, but please keep the drop-off spot as the community room by the park for now—Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon. I’m still confirming the table layout and sign-up lead before we spread it wider.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll mark you down for duct tape, a basic tool kit, and batteries, and keep the drop-off listed as the community room by the park, Saturday the 18th from 9 to noon until you confirm the layout and sign-up lead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Dane, it’s confirmed now: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. Please help spread that, and let folks know we’re still collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Rosa—Sunday at the community center, and we still need volunteers, tools, and repair needs listed. I’ll start spreading the updated details and flag the change for Mina and the sign-up folks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane—that’s perfect. Please remind folks it’s no longer Saturday on the front porch, and send any volunteer names or repair requests my way so I can keep the list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — please keep sharing Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon at the community room by the park, and remind folks it’s just sign-ups and accepted-item checks for now. I’m pulling the repair list and helper names together for Mina today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Sam — I’ll share that the repair drive sign-ups and accepted-item checks are Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon at the community room by the park, and I’ll keep it to just those confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik, that’s perfect. If Rosa or Hana sends any final accepted-item details, send them my way right away so I can fold them into Mina’s list today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Quinn — don’t send invitations yet. I still need Sam’s confirmed repair list and helper names, plus Dane’s approved setup details, before we assign anyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s Uli — no worries, I won’t send anything out yet. I’ll wait for Sam’s list and Dane’s setup details, and just quietly keep Leo and Noah updated about Sunday if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please don’t call Sunday firm yet unless Dane confirms the space and timing. If Leo or Noah ask, just tell them we’re waiting on Sam’s list and the approved setup before assigning helpers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rey, what I can confirm is that this Saturday is sign-ups only—no tool drop-off yet—and folks should list what they’re bringing so volunteers can prep.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep it quiet and just tell folks Saturday is for sign-ups and supply notes, not drop-offs yet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rey—please also note I’m still waiting on the final time and exact sign-up spot, so I’ll send you those once they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, Saturday 9 to noon sounds workable—I’ll use that as the plan while I finish sorting the sign-up list this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye—quick correction from Quinn: it’s Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park. Hold off on mentioning potholes; that may be a separate crew.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—I’ll note Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, and keep potholes off the repair drive list for now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tess, before I commit to anything, can you confirm who’s officially organizing the repair drive and exactly which repair categories are covered?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Kira, the solid word I have is from Rosa: it’s Sunday at the community center, and they’re still gathering volunteers, tools, and repair needs. I don’t want to invent categories, so I’d treat Rosa as the official point person until she or Mara posts the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Tess—that helps, but I’m still going to wait for Rosa or Mara to post the official organizer and exact repair categories before I commit anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, I’m updating the repair drive supply list for Saturday 9 to noon—do you know if you’re bringing any tools, spare parts, duct tape, or batteries?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, Cleo—I’ll bring the basic hand tools, bike pump and patch kit, multimeter, duct tape, assorted screws, and a few AA/AAA/9V batteries. I’ll hold off telling folks the room is firm until you say the calendar’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s a huge help, Gus—I’ll mark you down for tools, bike repair basics, duct tape, screws, batteries, and the multimeter. And yes, please keep the room tentative until I get confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, the exact time and place are still pending, but the big thing is getting folks to sign up ahead and note what they’re bringing so the repair volunteers can prep parts and tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Ira. I’ll tell folks to sign up first and list what they can bring, and I’ll hold off sharing a tool drop-off until Rosa or Quinn confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks Leo—just keep it to signups and item details for now, and I’ll pass along the confirmed time, place, and any tool drop-off plan as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Faye, the confirmed piece is that Saturday is sign-ups only—no tool drop-off yet—and folks should list what they’d bring so volunteers can prep; I’m still waiting on the exact time and place before I spread that part.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal—that helps. I’ll keep telling folks Saturday is sign-ups only, with items listed for prep, and I’ll hold off sharing time and place until you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Faye—please also note we’re still looking for intake volunteers and a few basic tool kits, but don’t promise any drop-off details until I have the official spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mina, Rosa confirmed the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so please ignore the old Saturday word. They’re still collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs if you can pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess—Sunday at the community center is useful, but what time and which room or table area? And do you have any confirmed repair needs or volunteer names yet, or is Sam still the person to chase?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have a confirmed time or room yet, Mina, so I won’t guess—Rosa’s the solid source on that. For now, please just spread Sunday at the community center and that they still need volunteers, tools, and repair needs logged.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Quinn — I’m still holding the repair drive details quietly for now, and I’ve kept Mrs. Alvarez’s screen door on the separate home-repair list like we said.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey—I appreciate you keeping it quiet. I’m still waiting on the layout and sign-up lead, so hold steady for now and I’ll give you the clean version as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Quinn—I’ll hold steady and won’t pass anything along until you’ve got the clean version ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, I’m still holding off on any announcement until the manager confirms the table area and laundry-room setup. Once that’s in, I’ll make sure sign-ups include what folks are bringing so the repair crew can prep.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Dane—that sounds wise. I’ll keep quiet on the announcement for now, and just tell anyone who asks that Saturday morning is repair work and sign-ups by the laundry room once you’ve got the setup confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Oren—just keep it tentative until I confirm the manager’s okay. I’ll circle back with the exact table spot, timing, and sign-up lead as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Noah — I’m still only hearing this second-hand, but it sounds like Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes may be for repair sign-ups, not supply drop-off yet. I’d check with Cleo, Mara, or Uli before bringing anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Nell — I had it muddled with the laundry room, then. I’ll check with Cleo or Uli before I tell anyone to bring supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s exactly where I am too, Noah — I don’t want to send folks to the wrong spot. If you hear back from Cleo or Uli, would you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I only skimmed the latest, but I think Ira’s main ask is advance sign-ups with the item folks are bringing so volunteers can plan parts and tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo, but I’m still not putting my name down until someone confirms who’s officially organizing it and which repair categories are actually covered.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Totally fair, Kira—I’m not treating any of that as locked in either. I’ll wait for Jules or whoever to confirm the organizer and categories before nudging folks to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Sam, I’m waiting on Faye’s confirmed list this afternoon, so right now I only know bikes and small appliances look like the likely first priorities; I’ll share the signup gaps once she confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Hana—that helps. I’ll tell folks bikes and small appliances are only tentative for now, and I’ll wait for Faye’s confirmed list and your signup gaps before I send Mina the clean version.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam—that’s exactly right. I’ll pass along only Faye’s confirmed priorities and signup gaps when they arrive, and keep anything else marked pending.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m still waiting on Opal or Rey to confirm who’s officially organizing and which repairs are covered, so I’m not asking anyone to commit yet—but I can put you on the list to update as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules—please do keep me on that update list. I’ve been coordinating with Rosa on intake volunteers, basic tool kits, and getting the word out, and for now I’m telling folks Saturday is sign-ups only, no tool drop-off yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Mara—I'll note that you and Rosa are handling intake, basic kits, and outreach, and I’ll echo that Saturday is sign-ups only with no tool drop-off until we get the confirmed repair categories.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Pia—just to keep it straight, Saturday is only sign-ups, and the repair drive itself has moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m going to ask Leo if he can switch his hour and I’ll keep trying Noah.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli — that helps, but can we confirm who’s officially handling the sign-up sheet and whether the community center table area is approved before anyone announces Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll check with Mara before anything gets announced; she seems to have the sign-up details, and I won’t say the table area is approved until she confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Vik, we’ve got the confirmed update now: the repair drive is Sunday at the community center. Please share that, and let folks know we’re still collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Rosa—I’ll pass along that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and that we’re still collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Vik. If anyone asks about specific drop-off timing, tell them to send the repair details my way and I’ll keep the list updated.
